purpose: connect to an outside service in a way that keeps working when the service is slow, changes or fails
entry_criteria: The integration need and the provider are chosen
The provider's documentation and terms are available
Credentials for a test environment exist
procedure: Read the provider's terms, limits and data handling rules, and confirm the data you send is allowed.
Wrap the provider behind an interface of your own, so the rest of the system does not depend on its details.
Set timeouts, bounded retries with backoff, and a circuit breaker so failures do not spread.
Verify incoming webhooks by signature, and handle repeated or out-of-order messages.
Keep credentials in secrets storage, rotate them, and give them the least access offered.
Test against the provider's sandbox, simulate failures, and monitor errors and quota use.
acceptance_criteria: The provider is behind an interface

validation.expect: timeout, error and repeated message cases pass

validation.check: send a webhook with a wrong signature to staging

failure_modes.mode: Provider outage stops the whole system

failure_modes.response: Throttle and alert before the limit

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A shipping-rate provider sits behind a small interface; calls time out at two seconds, retry twice with backoff, and fall back to a flat rate with a warning if the provider is down.
